title: Prabhas To Lose 'A Lot Of Weight', Get A Complete Makeover For Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit? | Telugu Cinema News - News18
text: The highly anticipated action drama Spirit, starring Prabhas, has been the talk of the town for quite some time. The film, directed by Animal filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga, made headlines because of many conflicts involving Deepika Padukone. Now, the film is back in the spotlight for all the right reasons. As per reports, Prabhas will undergo a massive transformation for the film. As per a Bollywood Hungama report, Prabhas’ look will be “radically different" from what the audiences have already seen. Their source mentioned, “He will be losing a lot of weight to look younger. He will also be sporting a new hairstyle and will be wearing clothes that he has never worn before. This role will take him far beyond his comfort zone. It will also be the first film to take Prabhas in a dark supernatural zone." Earlier, a source close to the project revealed, “Sandeep Reddy Vanga wants to shoot for Spirit in a certain way and has requested Prabhas to acquire a lean physique. The idea is to ensure most stunts are performed by Prabhas himself. The Rebel Star is excited about the challenge and is working closely with Sandeep to mould himself into the character." Director Sandeep Reddy Vanga recently confirmed that his much-anticipated film Spirit will begin shooting in September 2025. The announcement came during a chat with Vijay Deverakonda and filmmaker Gowtam Tinnanuri on Sithara Entertainment’s YouTube channel. Sandeep revealed that Spirit will have back-to-back schedules and a non-stop shooting plan once it hits the floors. According to reports by Rangasthalam, Sandeep has already completed the musical compositions for Spirit in collaboration with composer Harshavardhan Rameshwar. Backed by T-Series and Bhadrakali Pictures, Spirit is one of the most-awaited action dramas in Indian cinema and is expected to hit theatres in 2027. Spirit marks Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s next directorial outing after the success of Animal and features Prabhas in the role of a fierce police officer determined to dismantle a powerful underworld syndicate. The film promises high-octane action, intense drama, and a compelling storyline—a trademark of Vanga’s filmmaking style. Spirit made headlines earlier this year when Deepika Padukone exited the project following disagreements over working hours and compensation. Reports suggested that Deepika was advocating for a strict eight-hour workday, a demand that could not be accommodated by the production team. Following her exit, Triptii Dimri was roped in to play the female lead opposite Prabhas.
